blurb: Guests parasail up to 300 feet above Penticton, seeing views of the Penticton sign, Okanagan Lake, Skaha Lake, vineyards, hills, and cityscape. The experience includes a smooth takeoff and landing from the back of the boat, with an option for a water dip. Suitable for adventurers ages 4 and up, no swimming required.
